GET /{account_or_zone}/{account_or_zone_.description: Run a SQL query against account or zone-level datasets. The SQL query is passed as the `query` query parameter. Because the query appears in the URL, it is subject to gateway and proxy URL-length limits and may be recorded in access logs. This endpoint is deprecated in favour of the POST variant which sends the query in the request body.

parameters.name: account_or_zone
parameters.description: Whether ${account_or_zone} is an account ID (`accounts`) or a zone ID (`zones`).

parameters.name: account_or_zone_id
parameters.description: The account ID or zone ID, as selected by ${account_or_zone}.

403.description: Missing permission to access the requested resource.

422.description: The query needs more memory than a single query is allowed. Narrow the time range or simplify the aggregation.

507.description: Query exceeded internal memory or resource limits.

POST /{account_or_zone}/{account_or_zone.description:
Run a SQL query against account or zone-level datasets.

Timestamp fields are RFC3339 strings. Filter with:
  WHERE {timestamp_field} >= now() - INTERVAL '30' DAY
  WHERE {timestamp_field} >= '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z'
  WHERE {timestamp_field} BETWEEN '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-30T23:59:59Z'

List configured account or zone datasets to see enabled account or zone-level datasets.
Zone-level datasets will not appear here.
List available account or zone datasets to inspect their schemas and timestamp fields.

For more information about the datasets, and the meaning of each field, check out https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/logpush/logpush-job/datasets/
